answer: A random beacon and a compute heartbeat stop identity farming. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents; each must show a heartbeat in 60 seconds, an ember advanced every ten minutes. Joining locks a 30 POA bond, slashed on a missed check. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 POA in bonds plus 1,000 embers burning, against a 30,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays one bond, tends one ember for 0.5 POA, and sips the nectar, a bee in a saffron field.
